target.title: fix(ui): remove redundant esc label in file preview modal header
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves The file preview modal in the Skill Workshop has a redundant "esc" label in the header next to the file count, while the footer Close button already correctly displays an "esc" keyboard shortcut hint. This creates a confusing UI with duplicate Escape key indicators. Fixes #99027 ## Why This Change Was Made The `esc` in the header (``) has no meaningful purpose — it's not associated with any actionable element and misleads users about where the Escape shortcut applies. The correct "esc" label on the Close button in the footer is sufficient. ## User Impact - Removes the confusing duplicate "esc" badge from the header bar - Users will see only the correct "esc" hint on the Close button - No functional change — the Escape key handler is unaffected ## Evidence **Before:** Header shows ` files esc` with the "esc" badge, footer Close button also shows "esc" **After:** Header shows only ` files`, footer Close button retains "esc" hint ### Changes - `ui/src/ui/components/file-preview-modal.ts`: Removed redundant `esc` from header (line 407) and cleaned up unused `.esc` CSS rules
